caveats: Residual = observed minus predicted tide. It is a nowcast anomaly, not a surge forecast.
Outlook holds the latest residual constant (persistence): a placeholder, NOT surge guidance (synthetic: true).
Wilmington is up the Cape Fear River; its residual includes river flow and is not pure surge.
Southport has predictions only (no observed water level).
Does not include wave run-up, rain/drainage flooding, or river-surge interaction.
Road elevation comparison uses lidar crest with an allowance band; this comparison is never an all-clear for any road.
